extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers and applicants for Research Project Grants (RPGs)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for peer review and applicant navigation under NIH's simplified review framework for most Research Project Grant (RPG) applications, beginning with Jan 25, 2025 due dates. Emphasizes refocusing reviewer evaluation on core scientific/technical merit questions and shifting policy compliance activities to NIH staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary mission: identify the strongest, highest-impact research
rubrics_metrics.description: The simplified peer review framework aims to better facilitate the mission of scientific peer review – identification of the strongest, highest-impact research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the overarching objective guiding the changes to the review framework and reviewer focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Should the proposed research project be conducted?
rubrics_metrics.description: Should the proposed research project be conducted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the key questions reviewers are enabled to better focus on to assess the scientific and technical merit of proposed research projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Can the proposed research project be conducted?
rubrics_metrics.description: Can the proposed research project be conducted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A core feasibility assessment question for reviewers within the simplified framework, intended to evaluate whether the project can realistically be carried out as proposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator and environment evaluated within project context (mitigate reputational bias)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mitigating the effect of reputational bias by refocusing the evaluation of investigator/environment to within the context of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer assessment of the investigator(s) and environment should be made in relation to how they support the proposed research, rather than being driven by prior reputation; this change is intended to reduce reputational bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce reviewer burden by shifting policy compliance to NIH staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Reducing reviewer burden by shifting policy compliance activities to NIH staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy compliance activities that previously required reviewer attention will be handled by NIH staff so reviewers can concentrate on scientific and technical merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: framework applies to most competing Research Project Grant (RPG) applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Beginning with January 25, 2025 due dates, NIH implemented a simplified framework for the peer review of the majority of competing research project grant (RPG) applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes which applications are covered by the simplified review framework; applicants and reviewers should confirm applicability to a given funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant impact: little change in application content but affects funding opportunities used
rubrics_metrics.description: Although the simplified review framework has little impact on what is included in an application, it does have significant impact on the funding opportunities used to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note the practical implications for selecting appropriate funding opportunities and consult Applicant Guidance for navigating these changes, even though required application content remains largely unchanged.
